parameters.description: The voice to enhance: a voice id (your clone, a converted candidate or a flagship voice) or a `vox_emb_` candidate id. It keeps its language and is not modified.
parameters.name: src_voice

parameters.description: Number of candidates to produce. All candidates in one request are variations of the same speaker.
parameters.name: n_samples

parameters.description: The voice description, up to 500 characters. Must contain actual text, not only spaces.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Language the voice will speak. Shapes the accent and the delivery.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Number of candidate voices to sample from the description. All candidates in one request are variations on the same character.
parameters.name: n_samples

parameters.description: Look up a single candidate by id. Omit to list all candidates.
parameters.name: embedding_id

parameters.description: Also return Gradium catalog voices. Your organization's own voices come first, then catalog voices by `rank`, lowest first, unranked last.
parameters.name: include_catalog

parameters.description: Only voices of this locale, e.g. `en-nz` or `fr-fr`.
parameters.name: locale

parameters.description: Only voices of this gender: `male`, `female` or `neutral`.
parameters.name: gender

parameters.description: Only voices tagged with this use case, e.g. `Customer Service`, `Conversational`, `Narration` or `Ads & Social Media`. URL-encode it (`Ads%20%26%20Social%20Media`).
parameters.name: use_case

parameters.description: The voice to localize: a voice id (your clone, a converted candidate or a flagship voice) or a `vox_emb_` candidate id. The source is not modified.
parameters.name: src_voice

parameters.description: Language the candidates will speak. May equal the source language: that is an accent change.
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.description: One of the accents `GET /voice-generator/available-accents` lists for `target_language`, matched case-insensitively. Omitted: the first accent listed for that language.
parameters.name: accent

parameters.description: Opens the edit caption. Omitted: the source voice's gender tag, or the gender of the source candidate's own localization, or no gender. Clones and converted voices carry no tag, so send it for them.
parameters.name: gender

parameters.description: Number of candidates to produce. All candidates in one request are variations of the same localized speaker.
parameters.name: n_samples

description: Generate and transcribe speech, design voices, and manage pronunciation dictionaries.

gradium_new_candidate_trigger.description: Runs for each new voice candidate in Gradium. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields embedding_id, ready, prompt, language, created_at, expires_at, kind, generate_config.prompt, generate_config.language, edit_language_config.src_voice, edit_language_config.src_language, edit_language_config.target_language, edit_language_config.accent, edit_language_config.gender, enhance_config.src_voice, enhance_config.src_language

gradium_new_dictionary_trigger.description: Runs for each new pronunciation dictionary in Gradium. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields name, description, language, uid, org_uid, created_at, rules

gradium_new_voice_trigger.description: Runs for each new custom voice in Gradium. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uid, name, description, filename, start_s, is_catalog, is_pro_clone, language, rank, tags
